description: Artifact-free manual review guidance for native mobile, desktop, and unmodeled projects. It does not install or select an SDK.
purpose: Preserve the requested project goal while identifying platform, SDK, license, storage, architecture, and device requirements that need participant review.
detection: Use only the participant-approved project kind and coarse machine OS/architecture facts to select guidance. Inspect existing toolchain declarations before proposing changes; unknown details remain unresolved.
license_notes: Original Anza-authored metadata only; no vendor SDK, installer, or documentation content is included. Anza product-license approval remains pending.
side_effects: This record performs no installation, package download, license acceptance, device provisioning, project edit, or account change.
verification: Confirm all project-specific platform and SDK requirements with the participant and current vendor documentation; this manual record alone does not qualify any native runtime or build.
